problem: 用户否定中止图标、代码复制反馈、终端外围排版与 Case 固定卡片布局，旧视觉门未能拒绝明显失败。
scope: 任务详情微交互、终端工作区外围、Case 响应式布局、构建新鲜度与用户反馈沉淀；保留 xterm PTY 和后端任务语义。
baseline: CircleStop 套有边框、代码换行且悬浮蓝框、停止按钮增加空白行、终端普通表单化、Case 固定 180 到 220 像素。
benchmarks: VS Code Terminal Basics and Appearance
advantages: xterm.js 与 PTY 已真实运行
Edge 自动门已有宽窄视口
disadvantages: 旧门只证明元素存在和页面不溢出
外围布局未有密度量测
源码变化与用户可见构建曾缺少显式关联
limitations: 审美仍需结构化人工复核
横向代码滚动在短值上不会出现滑块
bottlenecks: 视觉 Oracle 缺少失败基线
hypotheses: 保留成熟终端内核并重做外围能直接修复可见问题
内在网格列可消除固定卡片空白
局部复制动画比 Toast 更紧凑
hard_gates: neutral hover and local copy confirmation
success_fixtures: long command scrolls inside its value
copy check appears without geometry change
Case rows remain compact at wide and narrow widths
rollback: Restore the last functional xterm/PT​​Y implementation while keeping the rejected Round 13 visual baseline as evidence.

iteration_budget.review_trigger: one browser hard-gate failure or one user-visible stale build

stop_conditions: current UI passes Edge geometry and interaction gates
skills and project requirements are updated

promotion_decision.reason: the icon, copy, terminal shell and intrinsic picker rules apply across operator tools

writeback: Project screenshots and values remain in quality evidence; cross-project rejection recovery and UI rules update user-root skills.
